title: SEBGRO
body:
**Good:** The tracker’s user interface is the best I've used, with easy statistics and notifications. The auto time-of-day feature outperforms any other app I've tried, and it operates flawlessly.

**Bad:** The app hasn't received substantial updates in years, only bug fixes. It has limited Siri integration and offers just one Watch complication that serves as a quick launcher.

**Very Bad:** After getting a new watch, I found the quick launcher complication missing. When I deleted and redownloaded the app, my premium account was reset. The only backup option is a manual data export, which is inconvenient.
